analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 43.6으로 중립 구간 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 아직 추세 전환을 확정하기는 이른 수준. ADX 31.0으로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나, 5일 저가가 20일 저가 대비 소폭 높은 Higher Low 패턴을 형성하며 회복 가능성을 시사. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 1.34배로 증가하며 움직임에 힘이 실리는 모습. 그러나 78,550원 스윙 저항선 돌파 여부가 불확실하여 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone at 43.6, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it's too early to confirm a trend reversal. ADX at 31.0 indicates a clear trend is maintained, but the 5-day low is slightly higher than the 20-day low, forming a Higher Low pattern suggesting recovery potential. Volume increased by 1.34x the 5-day average, adding momentum to the move. However, the uncertainty of breaking the 78,550 won swing resistance level warrants continued observation.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (78,550 KRW) vs SMA5 (72,335 KRW) / SMA20 (84,603 KRW) / SMA50 (98,648 KRW): below short-term trend, below mid-term trend
· Position relative to SMA100 (124,960 KRW) / SMA200 (112,769 KRW): below long-term trend, in weak territory
· 52-week position (19.0%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.7→43.6): exiting oversold, continuing in neutral zone, weakening upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3318.0421→453.1190): improving from bearish convergence, potential bottoming
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 84,603 KRW): band width 84.02% wide, current price consolidating near mid-band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (68,045 KRW): above Pivot S1 (54,575 KRW)
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW): breakout signals short-term bullish reversal
· 5-day high (83,815 KRW) > 20-day high (115,665 KRW) * 0.995 → Lower High pattern, continued weakness
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.34x): move gaining momentum, increased reliability
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider buying on breakout of 78,550 KRW resistance, maintain wait-and-see if not broken
